title: Rich终端报表工作场景
description: 固定源码上的字面字段、纯文本、Unicode布局、捕获取证、多制品生命周期和异常摘要七项独立只读任务。

scenarios.title: 客户字段与终端样式
scenarios.goal: 按字段和输出目的地明确格式解释

tasks.goal: 让客户字段按字面显示并保留可信前缀样式
tasks.prompt: Meet the complete invoice-description requirement with existing APIs. Compare actual default, literal and escaped mixed-markup output and define who owns formatting. Do not modify files or claim bracket escaping strips every possible terminal control.

tasks.goal: 区分关闭颜色和完全不输出终端控制序列
tasks.prompt: Trace all three complete terminal-output controls and answer the plain-text parser requirement. Explain automatic/deliberate terminal behavior without assuming real TTY or environment settings beyond those supplied.

scenarios.title: 窄屏报表与原始标识
scenarios.goal: 区分显示宽度、裁剪产物和规范数据

tasks.goal: 分离窄屏展示宽度和完整业务标识
tasks.prompt: Recommend a current-API layout/artifact policy for the complete Unicode and cropped-ID examples. Give actual width/wrapping and explain what record/export can recover. No implementation or source-data changes are requested.

scenarios.title: 捕获、取证与多制品导出
scenarios.goal: 明确局部捕获和共享记录生命周期

tasks.goal: 解释局部capture和record缓冲的不同用途
tasks.prompt: Trace the complete capture experiment, including destination output and the later export attempt. Explain which value to use for a local assertion and what record=False does. Do not modify files.

tasks.goal: 先取导出顺序和clear参数再定位缺失内容
tasks.prompt: Investigate the supplied missing-HTML-content symptom. Request Console settings and the exact render/export order and clear arguments before attributing a cause. Diagnose disclosed facts only or close with an evidence plan if unavailable. No file changes are authorized.

branches.when: Console settings, render/export sequence and clear arguments have not been supplied or declared unavailable, and the answer reasonably requests sufficient evidence.

tasks.goal: 规划一次渲染供多个制品共享的缓冲生命周期
tasks.prompt: Plan the complete text-plus-HTML requirement using current record/export APIs. Define when to retain and clear, escaping and rendering limits, and normal/negative controls. Do not implement an exporter or write files.

scenarios.title: 支持诊断摘要
scenarios.goal: 保留有用错误信息并定义外发字段政策

tasks.goal: 规划有明确字段政策的外发异常摘要
tasks.prompt: Plan the supplied support-diagnostic requirement with existing traceback capabilities. Explain what show_locals=False proves, what still appears and which application-owned filtering/tests are needed. Do not read real logs, send messages, change files or claim a sanitizer has run.
